findings.refutation: events append --tokens (events.js ~1055), budget check re-anchor (budget.js ~1190), park-reconsider.js ~149 and run-record-prd.js ~135 all wrap mutateLedgerUnderLock in a catch that degrades by design; a schema refusal is handled like LEDGER_LOCKED there. The ancestor-path ownership rule is the spec's own (Introduced violation).
findings.disposition_rationale: Proven false for the four named callers; ownership rule is spec-mandated.

The spec requires validateAgainstSchema strings to stay byte-identical, so property names and array lengths remain in messages; values never appear. Key names are PR-authored schema or ledger structure, not field values.
New exit-1 refusals are documented in the spec and surfaced on stderr; per-verb cli.md rows left for a docs pass.
bundle-recover write-once TOCTOU predates this change and is out of the spec scope; recorded as discovered scope.
A refused mint leaves a ledger-less run dir, the same as the existing lock-failure exit 3 path; the spec requires only that no run-ledger.json exists. Recorded as discovered scope.
Progress writers kept the unlocked read-modify-write posture by spec; not a regression.
Human renderer omits candidate_rejected; --json carries it, which is what CI consumes.
